sections.heading: Jobs and employment types
sections.text:
Work out if you're an employee or contractor, what to do when you leave the workforce or go overseas for work.

Check what tax applies to your different employee payments and what to do when you leave your job or the workforce.

Check if you're an independent contractor or employee and if you need to register for an ABN or certain tax roles.

Australian residents working overseas must be aware of their tax obligations before they leave Australia.

How to claim the tax-free threshold and what to do if you have a second job or other income.

When and how you as an employee or payee can vary your rate of PAYG withholding.

Check if you’re an employee or independent contractor and how you should be receiving your income.

How to determine if your activities are part of the sharing economy and the impact on your super and tax.

Defines what personal services income (PSI) is and how to correctly record and report PSI.
